item.title: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say 36 rose
item.description: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say 36 rose up in Pagasae & the Agora and the Reapers ran. Some already call the dead a martyr."
